title: Reference calibration without prior gain/lag trust

calibration.rule: Fit without receiving true gain, lag, or hidden disturbance; audit records real synthetic parameters only for external scoring.

limitations: Controlled excitation is directly applied to synthetic reference chain, not real hardware.
Validation indices differ but share same excitation and noise model; not proof of external validity.
Qualification uses model-dependent thresholds; no confidence interval with guaranteed coverage.
Only integer lags 0–2 and stationary gain are fit; fractional lag, drift, misregistration may fail.
Unknown hidden disturbance truth is used only to score audit, not to fit gain or timing.
A qualified reference is one sensor chain and does not establish three independent sensor roots.
Artificial computational measures; no physical nuclear fusion or fundamental forces.
